name: Murata Graphia, Founding Artist
description:
The ancestral progenitor of the painters of Benzaitengoku, and a remnant of Murata Graphia.
She once utilized the power of "Voracity" to imagenate phantasmal monstrosities for the Antimatter Legion. After witnessing the crash of the Astral Express, a vision of ascending to the heavens took root within her, leading her to turn against her own creator alongside the Nameless.
Ultimately, to protect this realm, she sought to encanvas all of existence. Within her lonely sorrow, she depicted the vengeful spirits fallen at the hands of Asat Pramad over and over again, until that very resentment finally drove her to madness.

skills.name: Cinder Crimson Blockprint
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Infernal Gory Blockprint
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to one designated target character, with a high chance to inflict "<u>Grudge Ablaze</u>."

skills.name: Infernal Gory Blockprint: Finest Ink
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to 2 designated target characters, with a high chance to inflict "<u>Grudge Ablaze</u>."

skills.name: Phantasmal Fiend-Sketch
skills.description: Summons "God-Devourer Offspring" and applies "<u>Beyond-Human Realm</u>" to all summons, then causes summons with 2 or more stacks of "<u>Beyond-Human Realm</u>" to immediately take action.

skills.name: Grand Vista: Devourer Murata
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to all targets with a high chance to inflict "<u>Grudge Ablaze</u>" to the attacked characters.

skills.name: Everburning Grudge
skills.description: Some of this unit's abilities inflict "<u>Grudge Ablaze</u>" on attacked target characters.
